source.paper: ZenKO: Guided and Iterative Quantum-Classical Method for Molecular Electronic Structure using Sample-Based Quantum Diagonalization

common_problem.hamiltonian: same prepared h1, h2, and constant energy for both methods
common_problem.reference: FCI or an explicitly identified trusted reference; do not mix references
common_problem.simulator_runtime: report separately; not quantum-hardware execution time

drift_trim.method: SqDRIFT sampling plus frozen accumulated-marginal selection
drift_trim.score: mean marginal CI weight over batches containing the string
drift_trim.candidate: sorted top-32 alpha and beta Cartesian product
drift_trim.sampling_evaluations: same shot and circuit-evaluation budget as ZenKO
drift_trim.classical_processing: include scoring, selection, batching, all candidate solves, and all restart solves

zenko.initialization: CCSD amplitudes and the same Hamiltonian

classical: all Hamiltonian construction and restart work

stop_rule: Do not tune either method on seeds 157-186; report all failures and budget overshoot.
